tools.name: priorseal_get_capabilities
tools.description: Read the live PriorSeal deployment capabilities before constructing a workflow.

tools.name: priorseal_prepare_authorization
tools.description: Canonicalize a bounded authorization and return the exact EIP-712 typed data or Solana message for a human-controlled principal to sign. This is read-only and never signs, submits, or executes a transaction.

tools.name: priorseal_prepare_controlled_execution
tools.description: Prepare a bounded authorization together with the deployment capabilities and a safe, explicit handoff plan. A human-controlled principal must still sign; this never accepts an authorization, signs, submits, or executes a transaction.

tools.name: priorseal_accept_authorization
tools.description: Verify and persist a principal-signed authorization. This can consume configured Agent credits and changes service state; send an idempotency key. It never signs, submits, or executes a transaction.

tools.name: priorseal_get_authorization
tools.description: Read an accepted authorization by its identifier.

tools.name: priorseal_observe_execution
tools.description: Persist an observation request for an already-submitted EVM or Solana transaction, then issue evidence when configured observation completes. A successful metered observation includes its first portable evidence bundle. This can consume configured Agent credits; send an idempotency key. It never bro

tools.name: priorseal_get_observation_job
tools.description: Read the durable status of an automatic finality-observation job.

tools.name: priorseal_get_receipt
tools.description: Read a signed execution receipt by its identifier.

tools.name: priorseal_get_evidence_bundle
tools.description: Get a free x402 purchase handoff for the portable receipt evidence bundle. This MCP result never includes the paid bundle itself.

tools.name: priorseal_get_evidence
tools.description: Get a free x402 purchase handoff for the chain-neutral Evidence API envelope. This MCP result never includes the paid envelope itself.

tools.name: priorseal_get_fresh_evidence_check
tools.description: Get a free x402 purchase handoff for a newly signed, read-only chain re-observation of an authorization-bound receipt.

tools.name: priorseal_verify_receipt
tools.description: Convenience-verify a PriorSeal receipt with the deployment key registry. Independent local verification remains required for trust decisions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: priorseal_prepare_authorization · Public sink: priorseal_accept_authorization, priorseal_observe_execution.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: priorseal_prepare_authorization · Public sink: priorseal_accept_authorization, priorseal_observe_execution

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "priorseal_observe_execution" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
